analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 21 Oct 2026
key_insights: Tech is leading the market at 12:36pm ET: super cap tech accounts for nearly 80% of NDX gains today, while only 57% of the S&P trades in the green. Volumes track 5% below the 20-day average and the index range is just 50bps as investors wait for tonight's events.

The desk sees signs of a momentum chase. The GS High Beta Mo basket is up 2.7% and SPCX call volume has passed 1mm contracts, which the desk reads as retail chasing that usually forces more demand for momentum.

Semis response to positive headlines was underwhelming, with SMH up only 1.7%. Bartlett notes recent poor performance and washed out positioning, but the desk's playbook is unchanged and it remains a better seller of the group.

META earnings preview: desk positioning score is 8/10 and the stock remains an overweight for most investors after an explosive move higher following the Muse release. Focus on the print will be Muse updates (download trend), broader AI monetization and product pipeline, the 2027 expense outlook, and any signals on 'capital' strategy.
FICC colleagues say the entirety of the credit market has its focus on META earnings.

Franchise flow is quiet, with activity 5% below recent averages and a balanced floor buy-sell skew. Long-only clients (LOs) are 7% better for sale, selling defensives to buy cyclicals. Hedge funds (HFs) are 3% better to buy, with demand concentrated in Tech and Consumer.
HF short ratio today is 61%, the highest seen month to date.

Chart of the Day: LO flow today is selling defensives to buy cyclicals on lower notionals, the opposite of HF activity month to date. Consumer Disc, Materials, Energy and Financials are among the most net sold sectors MTD, while Health Care, Real Estate and Staples are among the most net bought. The US Cyclicals basket (GSXUCYCL) long/short ratio is approaching 3-year lows, in the 5th percentile.
